A warm, ancient room setting. The Apostle Paul, an older man in simple robes with a chain on his wrist, is handing a small rolled parchment to a younger man, Onesimus, who is kneeling respectfully. The background shows the stone walls of a house arrest setting in Rome. Clean flat textbook illustration, white background.

A split diagram comparing the effects of Unforgiveness vs. Forgiveness. Left side (Unforgiveness): Dark red and gray colors. A person carrying a massive, heavy sack, looking stressed; a locked padlock above reading "God's forgiveness blocked"; an angry red arrow pointing to another person looking depressed. Right side (Forgiveness): Bright blue and yellow colors. The same person standing upright and happy, the heavy sack dropped on the floor; an open padlock above reading "God's forgiveness received"; two people shaking hands under a banner saying "Reconciliation".
